notes.title: Release v1.5.1
notes.notes:
Greetings,

Apologies for the delay in delivering this update, but it is with great joy that I can say that the release v1.5.1 is now available!

Below are the patch notes for this release.

Release Notes

New Features
New Options Menu
Revamped the existing options menu to be divided into multiple categories and included the new input remapping system and some gameplay related settings.

New Dungeon System
Revamped the dungeon system to display a new window with paths the player can take to reach the final boss, instead of a procedurally generated dungeon map

Button mapping System
Implemented a new system in the options menu to remap the keybinds

Replace shop with merchants
Replaced the "supermarket" from Aramore Town with new shop stalls with plans to create more in the next release.

Redesign Aramore Town
Started redesigning Aramore Town to look more appealing and lively

Bugs FixedMana Blast is casting Lightning
Fixed certain spells not showing the correct name, example: in certain cases, Lightning was showing up as Mana Blast

Carrot item is displaying as "Black Pants" in it's name
Fixed the "Carrot" item displaying as "Black Pants" when picked up from crops and in the item menu.

Bat sprite is missing
Fixed bat monster not displaying the right sprite when fighting

Shop options displaying on top of Shop Window
Fixed an issue where the message options for the shopkeep were displaying on top of the Buy/Sell window

Shop window is open, the NPC can still be interacted with
Fixed an issue where the Shop window was open but the NPC could still be interacted with, causing an issue where the message for that shopkeep would appear even though the Shop window was open.



That is all for this update.

I hope you continue to enjoy the game!

For the progress of the next release or to give feedback/report issues, please go to: Issue Tracker - Nemithia

Thank you for reading and I'll see you on the next update!

notes.title: Release v1.5.0 is now live!
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!

I'm happy to announce that the newest version of Nemithia is now live, after a long development process.

I want to also apologize for the delays in getting this update out. I had a lot of personal issues during the last year and ended up not being able to proceed with the development as I had hoped to.
Hopefully, the next updates won't take as long to come out!

With that out of the way, let's go to the release notes!

Release Notes
New Features

Menu Overhaul
Fight menu:
	Changed from buttons with text to icons
Pause Menu:
	Added icons to the options in the Pause Menu

Stat growth popup
[olist]Remade the Victory screen to show the character's exp gain/level up separately and then show the item drops earned from the fight;Remade the Defeat screen to be separate from the Victory Screen to better highlight a defeat.[/olist]
New Music
Added new music for the following:
[olist]Title ScreenArcadeBoss battleAramore ForestFightsIntro Chapter when the Drakians are invading[/olist]
Fight music
Fixed fight music speeding up whenever a party member is below 25% and make it trigger only when the party's average hp is below 25%

Chapter 1 Remake

The 1st chapter of the story has been remade to include more lore about the world, the tale of Arthur Runescar, and more.

Team + Character + Item menu overhaul


[olist]Party now shows as orange-colored characters in the Team MenuThe team menu now shows characters on both pagesThe item menu was changed to a tabbed window that filters items by categoryCharacter summary now shows tabs for:Character info + statsGrimoire and SpellsEquipmentElement mastery[/olist]
Improvements to load times

Slight improvement to the load times by optimizing the code to generate sprites based on the character's equipment.

Crops respawn time
Crops respawn timer has been set to 30 minutes of real-world time.

Intro

Added Story Intro and tutorial so the player can learn more about the world and the story

New Character Sprites

Remade all character sprites in a new style

Minigame adjustments
[olist]Less time for boulder breaking minigameLess time for dodge the rocks gameGive some money back at the end of the gameGive some item rewards depending on the gamePossible rewards:CollectiblesItems to raise a certain stat[/olist]
Fight System adjustments

Performance improvements to the fighting system

Interior Lighting
Added lights to the interior of houses, shops, etc.

Mobs in overworld

Mobs will now spawn in the overworld instead of being random encounters, some will also run towards the player.

New Health and Mana icons
Added new HP and MP icons for fights to highlight better what the bars represent

Skip dialogue button
Added a button to skip dialogue, currently mapped to Backspace on the keyboard.

Day/Night Cycle improvements
Changed the Day/Night cycle so that 1 real-world hour equals 1 day in the game


Bugs Fixed

Teleport after fight in dungeon
After any fight in a dungeon, the player was sent to an out-of-bounds location in the dungeon map

Arcade machines not allowing replay
Arcade machines were not allowing replay

Spells not launching
Spells like Lightning Bomb would appear on top of the character and not launch at its target

MP in fights
Fixed MP(Magic Points) not being drained on spell usage

Fix for Waystone message
Fixed the message that shows up whenever the player interacts with a Waystone

Crops Collision Detection
Sometimes when trying to pickup a crop(example: carrots) it wouldn't detect the collision properly

Fix for input icons
Fixed the icons that show the inputs for determined actions for the current controller/keyboard



As usual if anyone wants to report a bug or give feedback on the game, feel free to do so via the following methods:

 Opening a new ticket: Ticket System 
 Sending an email to: nunodiogo@omegaleo.pt
 Commenting on the discord server: Discord Server


With this I wish everyone happy holidays and also a happy new year!

notes.title: 19th February 2024 Public Beta Update
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone,

I apologize for the delay on bringing a new update for the game's public beta v1.5.0, been having some trouble balancing my work, university studies, and my duties as the game developer, work has been quite demanding these past few months and it has taken a bit of a toll on me and I apologize.

With that out of the way, here are the changes brought with this new update:

Bugs

 Dungeon generation

 Temporarily disabled dungeons due to an issue with the way dungeon rooms are generated, allowing the possibility for the player to get soft-locked if the dungeon key is generated on a side blocked by the boss room;
 In place of the usual dungeon entrances, there's now a statue in the forest part of the map that generates fights with the bosses currently available in the game, and future bosses as soon as they are made available.

 Spells not launching

 Fixed an issue with spells like Lightning Bomb appearing on top of the character and not being launched, causing a soft-lock mid-fight.

 Crops collision detection

 Fixed an issue where the collision detection for crops wasn't working properly so the player wouldn't be able to pick up the crop they were looking at.



Changes

 Post-fight screens

 The victory screen has been remade to show the character's exp gain/level up separately and display the item drops after the characters;
 The defeat screen as been remade to be separate from the victory screen so as to better highlight a defeat.

 Menu overhaul

 Removed the party option from the pause menu as it was no longer necessary
 Team menu

 Party members are now highlighted in orange;
 The menu now shows the list of characters on both pages;

 Item Menu

 The item menu was changed to a tabbed window that now allows players to filter them by category.

 Character summary screen

 This screen now shows the following tabs

 Character information and stats
 Grimoire and spells
 Equipment (and allow equipment to be changed in this screen)
 Element mastery (which will have a big role later on in the story)


 Pause menu

 Added icons to the pause menu options


 Minigame adjustments

 The boulder breaking and dodge the rocks minigames now take less time to finish;
 Minigames now give some money back at the end;
 Minigames now have a chance to give an item to raise a determined stat at the end.

 Day/Night cycle adjustments

 Changed the day/night cycle so that now 1 real-world hour is equal to a full day in the game

 Implemented a button mapping to allow players to skip the dialogue (still in testing)
 New music

 Added new music for:

 Title Screen
 Arcade
 Boss battle
 Aramore forest
 Fights
 Intro chapter when the drakians are invading




For instructions on how to switch to the public beta branch please look at the following video:
https://www.youtube.com/shorts/kUxfSahq1wE

This has been everything that's been done so far in terms of development, hopefully I'll be able to bring more regular updates soon.

As always any and all feedback is welcome and appreciated, the best options for it are either on the GitHub discussions forum or the discord server or via email to nunodiogo@omegaleo.pt.

Thank you for your continued support and I hope you'll keep enjoying the game.

Kind Regards,
Nuno "Omega Leo" Diogo

notes.title: Beta Update Week 1 August 2023
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone,

I know it's been a long time since I last posted an update to the game and I want to apologize for that, these last few months have been demanding both with my work and my private life and because of that, the game's development has suffered some delays.

With that said, I want to announce some new changes that can be tested in the public beta channel:

Story Intro
The game now has a proper story intro that shows some tutorials regarding movement and fighting and the battle between Arthur and Amolon Morrowstar.

Changes to the fight screen
The fight screen has been revamped and now has new icons for HP and MP and the old buttons with text for the various actions(Fight, Spells, Item, Switch) have been replaced with icon buttons to make it more compact.
https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FvUK2TjX0AMkzOr?format=jpg&name=medium

Changes to crops
After some feedback regarding the crop respawn timers some changes were made to reduce the times to an average of 30 minutes instead of being a daily occurrence.

Interior Lighting
The interior map has been changed to add lighting sources(Ceiling lights, moonlight through windows, etc.) during nighttime.

New Title screen
The title screen now has a new background that demonstrates the influence of the Drakians on Nemithia and new social icons have been added that lead to my discord server, youtube channel, and Twitch channel.

Quests
Quests are now being implemented and can be seen by pressing O to toggle open the Quest Panel.
For now, only some main quests will appear and side quests are planned to be implemented at a later update.
Quest tracking icons have also been added to the minimap and will always show to help point to where the player needs to go.

New character sprites
I'm currently in the process of remaking the overworld and fight sprites for all characters as will be apparent throughout this beta's gameplay, these are not final and some bugs may occur with rendering.

This has been everything that's been done so far in terms of game development and from now on I'll do my best to do these more regularly as well as try to stream more often and publish some devlogs on Youtube.

As always any and all feedback is welcome and appreciated, the best options for it are either on the GitHub discussions forum or the discord server.

Thank you for your time reading this post.

Kind Regards,
Nuno "Omega Leo" Diogo

notes.title: v1.4.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
The big moment we've all been waiting for is finally here! v1.4.0 has been released and with it come a lot of changes!

Bugs fixed

Tilemap tearing/green linesTilemap was showing some tearing/green lines in certain areas


Player is moving while saving game
Shop popup not showing Xbox One button
FightScene Background

FightScene Background's back layer was not aligning properly with the rest


Features implemented

New Achievements

Added new achievements to make the game more interesting

Stat Training
Added Stat Training option to raise the each party member's base stats(different from the stats that are shown in the character summary)

Character Balancing

Balanced characters in general and the experience points gained per fight

Upgraded fighting UI

Upgraded the Fighting UI to look more like an RPG one and to use the game's theme

Dodge and Critical Hit Mechanic
Added a Dodge and Critical Hit Mechanic that scales with Speed and Luck respectively

Post fight victory screen
Added a post fight victory screen to show teach character leveling up, amount of experience points and coins earned in the battle and also any drops that the enemy might've dropped

Message Text Alignment
Aligned the message text to Top Left to allow better reading of dialogue

Remake story chapter 1

Remade story chapter 1 to allow more player exploration and to make the plot longer

Map Function
Added a minimap to the Top Left corner of the screen to indicate important points of the current location and also the location name

Status Effects
Added Status Effects for Stunned, Burned, Poisoned

Suggestions implemented
Tell player to go to places
Tell player to go to places instead of just teleporting there, allowing for more breaks in the story and more exploration
More skills at the startAdded more skills to the characters at the start instead of being just punch
Italic for narrationMake narration text in italic instead of just normal to make it clear that it isn't a character talking
Indicate buying/sellingIndicate buying/selling by showing text on the screen
Make doors to outside clearerMake doors to outside clearer instead of just being a tiny opening in the wall tilesAll sprites the same size
Make all sprites the same size

Note: The game might still have a few bugs, to report any bugs please send an email to nunodiogo@omegaleo.pt or open a new thread in the community forum with all the information required to replicate the bug so I can fix it as soon as possible.

That is all.

Thank you all for your support of the game and I'll see you next time.
